stemMd: A circle has equation x² + y² + 4x − 6y − 12 = 0. What are its centre and radius?
explanationMd: Complete the squares: (x + 2)² + (y − 3)² = 12 + 4 + 9 = 25. Comparing with (x − a)² + (y − b)² = r² gives centre (−2, 3) and radius 5.

distractorRationale.a: This reverses the signs when reading completed squares.
distractorRationale.e: This ignores the constants added when completing the squares.
distractorRationale.c: The centre uses half the linear coefficients with opposite signs.
distractorRationale.b: Twenty-five is the squared radius, not the radius.
